start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:learn-the-person for my account: my name is Sam Example, supplied by me in this chat, and start with my work."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list named in its row: it reuses the person's own About me list when one exists, or makes one private list, and keeps the facts there.
instructions: 1. Optionally give name, name_source (who supplied the name and where) and focus; without a stated source a name is not used as proof.
2. Say "Run workflow:learn-the-person". It reads this account's identity, lists, messages, files and connected sources before changing anything.
3. It keeps each source-backed fact as a row with its exact quote in a private list, never overwriting what you confirmed, and keeps conflicts as separate rows.
4. Answer its questions one at a time about conflicts or gaps; your words are kept as person-confirmed and read back.
